title: ExperimentCreate
description: A proposed experiment: one knob, one or more clicks, against the setup a session was driven on.

session_id.description: Core's id of the session whose latest setup is the baseline.

clicks.description: Clicks to move it; negative is down. Never 0.

hypothesis_key.description: Key of the hypothesis in the session's latest diagnosis that this experiment tests. The hypothesis is then stored with its evidence and alternatives and marked as coming from the rules; without it the hypothesis is the human's own.

PredictionSpec.title: PredictionSpec
PredictionSpec.description: What the hypothesis expects of one channel, written before driving.

low.description: Smallest expected size of the change.

high.description: Largest expected size of the change.
